mapper.update: UPDATE product_label_versions SET food_type = #{foodType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, net_weight = #{netWeight, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ingredients_text = #{ingredientsText, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, allergens = #{allergens, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, manufacture_report_no = #{manufactureReportNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, packaging_material = #{packagingMaterial, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, shelf_life_months = #{shelfLifeMonths, jdbcType=INTEGER}, shelf_life_unit = #{shelfLifeUnit, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, storage = (SELECT sm.item_code FROM tb_common_code_item sm JOIN tb_common_code_group smg ON smg.common_code_group_id = sm.group_id AND smg.group_code = 'STORAGE_METHOD' JOIN tb_tenant smt ON smt.tenant_id = smg.tenant_id AND smt.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE NULLIF(#{storage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '') IS NOT NULL AND (sm.item_code = #{storage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR sm.item_nm = #{storage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR (split_part(sm.item_nm, '(', 1) <> '' AND strpos(#{storage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, split_part(sm.item_nm, '(', 1)) > 0)) ORDER BY CASE WHEN sm.item_code = #{storage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 0 WHEN sm.item_nm = #{storage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, sm.sort_order, sm.item_code LIMIT 1), extra = COALESCE(#{extraJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, extra), updated_at = #{now}, updated_by = #{who, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id = #{id}
